ai_overview_text:
Chemical process plant equipment refers to the `specialized machinery, vessels, and tools used to handle, mix, heat, cool, separate, and transform raw materials into finished chemical products safely and efficiently`.[[1]](https://ensun.io/search/chemical-process-equipment)
---

### Main Categories of Chemical Process Equipment

- **Reaction Equipment (Reactors):** Vessels where chemical reactions occur under controlled temperatures, pressures, and agitation to convert raw materials into new compounds.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HoV5FfRyelM&t=122)
- **Separation Equipment:** Units that split mixtures into individual components based on physical properties:
	- **Distillation and Fractionation Columns:** Separate liquid mixtures using boiling point differences.
	- **Extractors and Absorbers:** Use solvent affinity or mass transfer gradients to pull specific components from a stream.
	- **Filters and Cyclones:** Remove solid particles from liquids or gases using membranes or centrifugal force.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ETk7HzUuJ4&t=6)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HoV5FfRyelM&t=122)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZIJbR05lK4Y&t=53)
- **Heat Transfer Equipment:** Systems that heat, cool, condense, or evaporate fluids without direct mixing:
	- **Heat Exchangers** (shell-and-tube, plate, or air-cooled types).
	- **Boilers, Furnaces, and Condensers**.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ETk7HzUuJ4&t=6)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HoV5FfRyelM&t=122)
- **Fluid Handling Equipment:** Machinery that transports and pressurizes liquids and gases:
	- **Pumps** for moving liquid streams.
	- **Compressors and Turbines** for increasing gas pressure and momentum.[[1]](https://www.idexindia.in/industrial-chemical-processing-equipment/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ETk7HzUuJ4&t=6)
- **Solid and Powder Handling Equipment:** Tools that break down or blend solids:
	- **Crushers and Grinders** 
	- **Agitators, Mixers, and Powder Blenders** [[1]](https://www.cem-int.com.au/industries/chemical/)[[2]](https://www.idexindia.in/industrial-chemical-processing-equipment/)
- **Stationary Vessels and Storage Tanks:** Enclosed or open containers used to hold raw materials, intermediate products, or finished chemicals (including horizontal vessels, tall vertical columns, and large storage tanks).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ETk7HzUuJ4&t=6)[[2]](https://www.scribd.com/presentation/52985166/UNIT-1)
- **Utilities and Auxiliary Systems:** Support infrastructure like **cooling towers**, **boilers/steam systems**, **wastewater treatment units** , and **compressed air or nitrogen generators**.[[1]](https://www.quora.com/Which-are-equipments-using-in-chemical-industry)


---

### Key Equipment Classifications

- **Rotary Equipment:** Driven machines with moving or rotating parts (such as motors, pumps, and compressors).
- **Stationary Equipment:** Fixed mechanical or structural components (such as piping, storage tanks, valves, and heat exchangers).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ETk7HzUuJ4&t=6)
